train_dedupe_chunks.note: RegexTokenizer.train keeps each distinct regex chunk once (first-seen order) with its multiplicity and counts pairs weighted. Pair counts and their first-seen order are unchanged, so max() picks the same merges, ties included.

encode_chunk_cache.note: encode_ordinary encodes each distinct regex chunk once per call (a call-local dict), since chunks such as ' the' or ',' repeat; the cache never outlives the call, so later changes to merges cannot make it stale.
